Hi, we don’t have tickets or insurance or whatever yet, it makes no sense because they can say no. 
 We sent 
Invitee passport 
Invitation letter stating why, when, how long and where he will stay 
Pictures of you/your partner with the invitee
Documents that prove that he has roots in the country like lease/house ownership, payslips etc 
Invitee birth certificate 

I was told that the translation of the extra documents can be done by yourself but ofc accepting depends on the clerk. 

Even if they ask less, just send everything
